shared_elements: standing human figures in profile/frontal schematic form
disc or sun-like circular motif with radiating lines
small repeated marks arranged in rows or lines
justification: Both surfaces depict schematic standing human figures with raised arms and a circular disc motif (concentric/rayed circles in A, a rayed sun disc in B), and both include series of small repeated marks (cupmarks in A, sign rows in B). But A is an open, scattered field of oversized figures with boats, lurs and no framing or writing, while B is a strictly framed, register-based composition with an offering scene above a dense body of pictorial script, so the organising schemes and relationships share nothing specific.
